integrity: The infinite-family statements follow from an analytic proof; modular-rank checks, exact radial identities and finite Lindblad propagation are reproducibility checks, not independent certification.
limitations: Fixed finite dimension, unweighted adjacency, arbitrary strictly positive rank-one site-dephasing at all and only weight-two vertices; no uniform mixing-rate estimate or robustness to Hamiltonian disorder. The exact Fourier rank methods and general quantum-semigroup structure are prior methods; publication-level uniqueness has residual risk.
title: Perfect-square corner revivals under distance-two-shell dephasing of a quantum hypercube
